collection.description: River water rises toward the sleeping huts.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: River water rises toward the sleeping huts.

choices.label: Ask a Magic adept to turn the water.
Study the banks and dig a channel.
Gather everyone to pray and prepare.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The current bends around the huts, but the adept collapses from exhaustion.

text_only.reason: the adept collapses from exhaustion, not a structure

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The water ignores the attempt, and precious time passes.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A carefully placed ditch spares the homes.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The ritual steadies frightened families while volunteers move supplies.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The flood still arrives, and some villagers resent the lost time.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A wall of stones holds until morning.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The wall breaks, but the warning gives families time to flee.

b2__fx.name: Outcome B2
b2__fx.text: The ditch sends muddy water into the gardens.

b2__text.name: Outcome B2
b2__text.text: The ditch sends muddy water into the gardens.
